decisions.intent: Preserve fuzzy sustain and the clean brass voice's punch and smooth character while using one MIDI track.
decisions.implementation: An Instrument Rack contains Original Fuzz Brass with the original Analog, EQ Eight and Heavy Tube path, plus Clean Brass Voice copied from the muted duplicate. The clean voice has a higher second oscillator octave and different internal amp levels. The earlier effects-only clean bypass remains at minimum level; the duplicate track remains muted as a reference.
decisions.verification: User auditioned the two-voice rack and chose to keep it. Reducing Heavy Tube wetness and adding only a bypass of the original synth did not reproduce the desired clean voice.
